connector.name: MCP by hushvert.com
connector.registryDescription: File conversion for AI agents: office docs, PDF to Word, video, and LLM-ready markdown via API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.hushvert. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HUSHVERT_API_KEY
env.description: hushvert developer API key (hv_live_...), from https://hushvert.com/developers/keys

env.name: HUSHVERT_ALLOWED_DIR
env.description: Optional directory jail: every file read/write must resolve under this path
